mainEntity.name: When should my business consider implementing topic clusters for AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your business should consider implementing topic clusters for AEO when you aim to establish strong authority in your niche, improve organic visibility for a wide range of related queries, and capture more featured snippets or direct answers. This strategy is particularly beneficial if your existing content is disorganized, has keyword cannibalization issues, or struggles to rank for complex, long-tail questions. It's also ideal when you have sufficient resources to consistently produce high-quality, in-depth content that addresses various aspects of a core topic, providing a comprehensive resource for users and search engines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider implementing topic clusters when you want to build authority, improve visibility for diverse queries, capture featured snippets, and address disorganized content or keyword cannibalization.
